inputs.style: Gentle instrumental game defeat reflection, 72 BPM, B minor resolving toward D major. Felt piano, soft cello played with a bow, sparse celesta and warm synth pad made from pure instrumental tones. Bittersweet, encouraging, understated and calm. No dramatic impact, no percussion wall, no choir texture. Original video game instrumental score. Only musical instruments. No vocals, no singing, no speech, no choir, no humming, no vocal samples. Clear melodic phrases, restrained dynamics, spacious clean production, gentle high frequencies, controlled bass, seamless flowing arrangement.
inputs.lyrics:
[Instrumental opening: soft felt piano and quiet cello]
[Instrumental reflection: celesta repeats a hopeful four-note motif]
[Instrumental ending: warm major harmony with a gentle sustained piano chord]
